name: Panasonic EVQP2, short travel, ground terminal (EVQP2V02M)
description: Panasonic EVQP2 tactile switch, short push travel, J-bent terminals, with the ground terminal: base 4.7 × 3.5 mm, 2.1 mm high.

citation.document: Panasonic Industry, Tactile Switches 4.7 mm × 3.5 mm SMD, Type EVQP2, EVQP9, EVQ3P2 (ANCTB19E): EVQP2 short push travel with ground terminal, external dimensions and PWB land pattern

note: Base, height (H = 2.1 mm), push plate, terminals and the lands (6.6 / 3.7 / 0.7 / 2.7 mm and the ground land 1.4 mm, read between 1.7 and 2.35 mm from the centre) from the drawing; the cover top (0.55 mm below the plate) and the terminal and cover sheet thicknesses are estimated. name: Panasonic EVQP2V02M on the switch lands only, terminals separate

citation.document: Panasonic Industry, Tactile Switches 4.7 mm × 3.5 mm SMD, Type EVQP2, EVQP9, EVQ3P2 (ANCTB19E): EVQP2 short push travel with ground terminal, external dimensions and PWB land pattern
